title: A home that feels considered.
subtitle: Mineral & Walnut, refined around your life.
position: Original Mineral & Walnut: warm ivory and soft mushroom mineral walls, rich walnut, natural oak floors, ivory textiles, dark accents and greenery. Individual rooms share this warm modern foundation.
scope: Original 24-space / 45-view design restored. Twenty-four paired night views and practical refinements stay within the Option 1 palette. All construction dimensions and products need verification.

rules.title: Start with the room’s job
rules.text: Plan the walk, the seat, the light and the place to put a drink before choosing decoration. Write down the daily routine and the storage it needs.

rules.title: Give each view a hierarchy
rules.text: Choose a lead element, then supporting elements. Your TV and fireplace can read as one composition. A room can have several functional zones without every wall becoming a feature.

rules.title: Keep the materials related
rules.text: Natural oak floors, warm mineral/ivory walls, rich walnut and restrained black accents carry across the house. Repeat these materials with different proportions and silhouettes in each room.

rules.title: Vary the silhouettes
rules.text: Balance soft upholstery, rounded tables and substantial walnut storage. Use legs, plinths or floating details according to the room and practical construction needs.

rules.title: Design for daylight and evening
rules.text: Test material boards near several windows and under the intended lamps. Use sheers for softness, a separate privacy or blackout layer where needed, and controllable task and accent light.

rules.title: Leave something unfilled
rules.text: Empty wall and clear surfaces give art and architecture room to matter. Collectibles, family photos and seasonal decor belong in intentional groups, with storage for the rest.

materials.title: Walls: quiet mineral character
materials.use: Propose Roman Clay on selected dry focal surfaces, with washable warm matte paint elsewhere. Keep the application smooth and subtle in this sunlit house.
materials.detail: Price surface preparation separately. Compare a real sample of each finish with the same floor, upholstery and trim; the render does not specify a paint color.

materials.title: Limewash: an alternative finish
materials.use: Use when a softer brushed, cloudy surface is wanted. It is not an automatic protective layer over decorative paint.
materials.detail: Follow the selected system’s primer and sealer instructions. A wipeable surface is not a waterproof splash assembly; use appropriate tile/stone and substrate systems at wet zones.

materials.title: Floors: continuity with purpose
materials.use: Budget replacement natural oak in connected dry spaces and all four bedrooms, with separate rugs. Keep a single coordinated undertone through circulation and adjacent rooms.
materials.detail: Wet bathrooms, laundry needs and the gym may need different appropriate materials. Check substrate, moisture, stair levels and thresholds. Wide planks alone do not make a floor better.

materials.title: Walnut + dark accents
materials.use: Use rich walnut for selected cabinetry, consoles and the owner-suite headwall. Natural oak flooring keeps the backdrop lighter; restrained black frames and hardware provide definition.
materials.detail: Approve a shared walnut sample. Grain, veneer sequencing, edge details and hardware quality matter more than repeating the same furniture shape everywhere.

materials.title: Drapery: daylight and privacy
materials.use: Full-height ivory sheers plus side panels; add blackout in bedrooms and a light-control layer for cinema use.
materials.detail: Measure the actual track width, heading, stack-back and floor variation. Specify fullness with the workroom for that fabric/heading; do not blindly multiply window width. Sheers alone do not guarantee night privacy.

materials.title: Light: layered, quiet and serviceable
materials.use: Design target: 2700K in relaxed spaces and coordinated 3000K task areas, or compatible warm-dim systems; judge connected sightlines as a whole.
materials.detail: Aim for 90+ CRI, but also check glare, output, dimmer compatibility and flicker. Mock up the actual fixture and control. Keep LED drivers accessible and dots out of view.

qualifications: “Go bigger”
Choose the largest piece that still fits circulation, doors, reach and daily use. Our dining table needs a plan test before any increase.
“One focal point”
Use a clear visual hierarchy within each view or zone; a fireplace and TV can be one composition. Keep the existing TV location unless separately redesigned.
“Never mix color temperatures”
Avoid accidental mismatches within a scene. Deliberate warm-dim lamps or task layers can coexist when tested together.
“Paint is two shades darker on a full wall”
There is no reliable fixed two-shade conversion. Test large physical samples across daylight and evening conditions.
“50% strength means half as dark”
A tint formula change is not a predictable lightness conversion. Select and sample the actual proposed color.
“Satin everywhere wet; flat everywhere dry”
Choose an actual coating system for cleaning, moisture and substrate. Sheen alone does not establish durability or waterproofing.
“One antique / three repeats / 60–30–10”
Useful prompts, not quotas. Personal pieces and visual balance matter more than counting objects or percentages.
“Buy custom for a luxury result”
Custom solves a specific fit or storage problem. Use well-made retail furniture; quote stock boxes with tailored fronts where appropriate. No guaranteed saving percentage.
“Replace all ordinary finishes”
Spend where an upgrade changes comfort, function or a key view. Retention, refinishing and good installation can be the better choice.
“TV distance is a fixed diagonal multiple”
Use the chosen screen, resolution, content, viewing preference and actual seat location. Test at full size; the playbook’s multiplier is not universal.
measurements: Main circulation
Start around 36 in clear; aim for more on busy routes
Planning target, not an accessibility or code approval; include open doors and drawer positions.
Kitchen work aisles
42 in for one cook / 48 in for multiple cooks
NKBA design recommendations; measure counter/appliance fronts. Accessible layouts and local requirements may need more.
Dining circulation
Aim for 42–48 in where people pass behind seats
Check the real pulled-out chair and cabinet projection. Table-to-wall arithmetic alone is not a usable aisle.
Sofa to coffee table
Start around 14–18 in
Adjust to seat depth, knee room, reach and mobility. Do not sacrifice the main route.
Artwork
Start near 57–60 in center on an open wall
Artwork over furniture relates to the furniture and architecture; mock it up rather than forcing eye-level rules.
Rug sizing
Keep the seating group connected; allow dining chairs to stay on the rug
Use actual furniture footprints. A larger rug cannot correct an oversized table.
Bedside use
Start with 30–36 in comfortable circulation where feasible
Coordinate with bed drawers, door swings and the user’s access needs; measure nightstands against the actual mattress.
Pendents + chandeliers
Use the table/island, fixture scale and sightline
The room-length-plus-width formula is only a sketch; actual fixture instructions and clearance requirements govern.

phases.title: 01 · Resolve and sample
phases.text: Measure the house, tape furniture layouts and approve a shared material board. Resolve Bedroom 5 construction, Bedroom 2 geometry, dining clearances and nighttime privacy.
phases.spend: Pay for the survey, drawings and real samples before committing to fabrication.

phases.title: 02 · Coordinate fixed work
phases.text: Assume most finishes need replacement. Coordinate Bedroom 5 partitions, flooring, wet-room systems, electrical changes and useful walnut built-ins. Retain service locations where feasible.
phases.spend: Quote prep, materials, installation, disposal and tax separately; compare retention and replacement where realistic.

phases.title: 03 · Build the comfort layer
phases.text: Buy new furniture against an agreed schedule: beds and mattresses, seating, rugs, drapery and useful tables. Furnish the primary living and sleeping rooms first.
phases.spend: Prioritize touch points and daily comfort. Keep a contingency appropriate to the surveyed scope rather than a universal furnishing percentage.

phases.title: 04 · Collect and adjust
phases.text: Add art, plants and seasonal decoration once the core rooms work. Later purchases may be phased; they are deferred costs, not permanent savings.
phases.spend: Use movable accents for experiments. Avoid a whole-house replacement order before the first rooms work.

checks: measure
Measured plans include doors, windows, services and delivery routes.
furniture
New furniture is measured, budgeted and allocated by room before ordering.
sample
Wall, floor, wood, metal and textile samples reviewed together in daylight and evening light.
layout
Furniture taped out; doors, drawers and chairs operate without blocking key routes.
privacy
Sheer, privacy and blackout needs tested after dark.
light
Lighting layers, control compatibility, glare and service access checked.
joinery
Joinery drawings show hardware, hinges, supports, power and ventilation.
wet
Wet-zone materials and waterproofing system coordinated with installer.
budget
Quotes separate materials, prep and labor; quantities, lead times and contingency are recorded.
handoff
Finish/product schedule, sample references, drawings and open questions issued together.
seasonal: Keep the permanent background calm. Christmas can bring evergreen, deep red, silver or warm lights; Halloween can use charcoal, amber and branches. Rotate a few textiles and objects, retain clear walkways, and reserve a storage location for each seasonal set. No permanent yellow/blue requirement.

rooms.title: Entrance gallery
rooms.diagnosis: Let the two-story cascade and arch lead; quiet the wall texture and keep the natural-oak floor consistent with floor two.
rooms.keep: Light glazed side doors, both inscriptions, natural front door and existing stair/landing.
rooms.improve: A compact concealed drop zone only where measured door swings allow; fewer tabletop objects.
rooms.verify: Template lettering at full size; coordinate chandelier service access, attachments and visibility from both floors.

rooms.title: Home office
rooms.diagnosis: Give the full north wall a clear rhythm of closed storage and a few open display bays. Keep the TV and soundbar central.
rooms.keep: Large rectangular desk facing northwest; artwork and compact printer cabinet to the right of the entry.
rooms.improve: Walnut cabinetry with varied closed doors and limited display bays. Add reachable task light, concealed cable routing and a practical printer cabinet.
rooms.verify: Check chair pullback, printer ventilation/service access and video-call light; do not bury equipment behind sealed doors.

rooms.title: Media room
rooms.diagnosis: Reduce visual competition around the 83-inch screen. Keep collectables in one controlled display zone beside the clear doors.
rooms.keep: West-wall doorway, clear glazing, generous Cloud-style seating, soundbar and surround/ceiling audio.
rooms.improve: Use a smooth darker TV backdrop, subtle dimmable halo and a quieter low console; substantial loose rug and light-control lining.
rooms.verify: Choose one compatible audio system before wiring. Rear surrounds and overhead effects serve different jobs; do not specify a random soundbar plus unrelated passive speakers.

rooms.title: Studio gym
rooms.diagnosis: Use a resilient floor and uncluttered mirror wall; keep the quote as the personal focal detail.
rooms.keep: Empty room; northwest closet; “Surpass your limits. Right here, right now.”
rooms.improve: A clean mirror edge, washable surrounding walls and glare-controlled light. Keep future equipment footprints free.
rooms.verify: Confirm mirror safety backing, wall fixing, ventilation and floor/equipment suitability when equipment is selected.

rooms.title: Bath #3
rooms.diagnosis: Make mirror, light and vanity a single considered composition.
rooms.keep: Existing fixture zones and compact plan-led layout.
rooms.improve: Warm neutral tile, a small characterful mirror and one rich wood vanity. Use decorative mineral finish only on eligible dry walls.
rooms.verify: Field survey this room before quantities or fabrication; no original room photograph exists.

rooms.title: Great room
rooms.diagnosis: Keep the fireplace/TV composition calm; give the white seating a little contrast and useful places to set a drink.
rooms.keep: Both high transoms, terrace access and sibling artwork above both consoles.
rooms.improve: Keep walnut consoles, sibling neutral artwork, ivory seating, useful coffee/side tables, quiet mineral walls and a tall plant. Improve comfort and scale without changing the material palette.
rooms.verify: Measure sofa modules and walk paths. Tape TV height for seated viewing; fireplace and TV manufacturer heat/clearance instructions govern the retained above-fireplace location.

rooms.title: Kitchen
rooms.diagnosis: The cabinets, floor and stone currently compete in grain and warmth; simplify that material mix.
rooms.keep: Existing layout, right-end wall-oven column, island and improved dome pendants.
rooms.improve: Use replacement stock or semi-custom warm-ivory cabinetry with a walnut island and quiet pale counters. Keep existing service positions and coordinate the oak floor undertone.
rooms.verify: Measure aisles with appliance doors open. Confirm range ventilation, landing surfaces and actual pendant dimensions before ordering.

rooms.title: Formal dining
rooms.diagnosis: Make the table and chandelier the main event, with a shallow useful piece under the high window.
rooms.keep: Five original windows, niche, ten-seat rectangular entertaining layout and sheer drapes.
rooms.improve: Refine table support positions, soften corners, simplify surface styling, and use a closed shallow cabinet instead of another small-object display. Explore an extension mechanism while keeping ten seats available.
rooms.verify: The 108 × 42 in concept is tight at the ends after adding storage. Test chair widths, support positions and cabinet depth on a measured plan; do not assume ten chairs prove ten comfortable seats.

rooms.title: Living room · piano salon
rooms.diagnosis: Let the baby grand be the focal point, with Cloud seating arranged for conversation.
rooms.keep: Baby grand, white sofa and clear drapes; room remains a plan-led concept.
rooms.improve: One generous rug, an individual chair and a single calm artwork. Keep the piano finish distinct from oak floors and warm walls.
rooms.verify: Verify exact piano outline, lid swing, bench withdrawal and delivery path. Coordinate daylight control with the piano maker’s care guidance.

rooms.title: Sunroom
rooms.diagnosis: Keep the six-seat rectangle light in scale so the glazing remains the experience.
rooms.keep: Six seats, rectangular table, improved chandelier and transparent drapes.
rooms.improve: A low-maintenance tabletop, slim comfortable chairs and one sculptural pendant family distinct from formal dining.
rooms.verify: Check chair pullback, drape stack and adjacent kitchen appliance doors. Sheers diffuse light; they are not reliable night privacy.

rooms.title: Second-floor stair hall
rooms.diagnosis: Use restrained wall texture and art that can be read while moving between floors.
rooms.keep: Quarter-turn/curved rise, halfway landing and onward straight flight; existing guard and openings.
rooms.improve: Continuous oak/ivory family, quiet dark rail, one art moment rather than repeated illuminated walls.
rooms.verify: Verify stair geometry from survey and photos. Keep objects and lighting projections outside the required passage/guard clearances.

rooms.title: Owners suite
rooms.diagnosis: Make the bed the clear focus and reduce the intensity of decorative lighting and wall mottling.
rooms.keep: White platform bed, art above, 55-inch TV/soundbar opposite, walnut headwall band and floating bedside consoles.
rooms.improve: Walnut headwall and floating bedside pieces, new ivory upholstered platform bed, walnut dresser, layered sheer/blackout curtains and individual reading lights. Keep any decorative LEDs subtle.
rooms.verify: Check mattress-to-nightstand height, bedside controls, underbed driver access and full drawer opening; avoid visible LED points.

rooms.title: Owners retreat
rooms.diagnosis: A small coffee bar and relaxed seats should feel like an extension of the suite.
rooms.keep: Bar plumbing, glazing and existing room relationships.
rooms.improve: Reduce counter clutter; add a useful tray, warm task light and one distinctive lounge fabric. Match adjacent bedroom flooring in every sightline.
rooms.verify: Allow coffee-machine clearance, protected splash surface and accessible plumbing/electrical service.

rooms.title: Owners bathroom
rooms.diagnosis: Keep the artwork above the tub; give mirrors and practical face lighting priority over decorative effects.
rooms.keep: Tub, shower, windows, double vanity and artwork location.
rooms.improve: Limit the tile palette; soften grout contrast and use calm dry-wall paint. Size storage around actual toiletries.
rooms.verify: Choose slip suitability and the complete shower waterproofing system with the trade. A decorative sealer is not waterproofing. Keep art clear of splash exposure.

rooms.title: Owners walk-in closet
rooms.diagnosis: Improve visibility and storage fit before adding decorative wood.
rooms.keep: Existing walk-in footprint and door position.
rooms.improve: Use mostly warm-ivory modular interiors with selected wood drawers; light clothes from the front of the bays.
rooms.verify: Inventory hanging lengths, folded items and shoes; confirm opening drawers do not trap the central aisle.

rooms.title: Bedroom 2
rooms.diagnosis: Keep the west-wall headboard and give the desk its own useful light.
rooms.keep: West-wall headboard, door in south portion of west wall; desk to right/south of east window.
rooms.improve: A soft upholstered headboard, restrained narrow stripe in textiles and simple plinth storage. Oak floor with a separate rug.
rooms.verify: Resolve the documented entry/closet relationship with a site measure before treating the render as a furniture plan.

rooms.title: Bedroom 3
rooms.diagnosis: Allow the windows and upholstered bed to lead; avoid a miniature copy of the owners suite.
rooms.keep: Bed on right wall between its windows; oak floor and separate rug.
rooms.improve: A linen-like texture, small charcoal accents and simple varied bedside pieces; add blackout behind the airy daytime layer.
rooms.verify: Keep curtain stacks clear of bed and outlets; verify real bed width and drawer opening in this smaller room.

rooms.title: Shared bathroom
rooms.mood: Simple, durable and easy to share
rooms.diagnosis: Give each user an organized storage zone and flattering light.
rooms.keep: Double-vanity and adjacent bedroom connections.
rooms.improve: A quiet porcelain family, coordinated mirrors and easy-clean surfaces; keep decorative objects sparse.
rooms.verify: Coordinate outlets, exhaust, storage and shower waterproofing; tile size follows drainage/slope as well as appearance.

rooms.title: Laundry
rooms.mood: A useful room with a little wit
rooms.diagnosis: Keep “Rinse and repeat..” and its graphic; improve sorting and folding instead of adding decor.
rooms.keep: Sink and both windows on left wall; washer/dryer locations and selected lettering.
rooms.improve: Closed detergent storage, washable walls and a properly supported folding surface.
rooms.verify: Use actual appliance cut sheets for ventilation, door swing and service removal; protect the sink splash zone.

rooms.title: Third-floor stair hall
rooms.diagnosis: Continue the house palette with one quieter art composition.
rooms.keep: Actual stair/landing layout, high windows and guard.
rooms.improve: Use one durable wall finish through connected landings; retain the view of daylight and clear floor area.
rooms.verify: Coordinate accessible light maintenance and switch/control locations with the electrician.

rooms.title: Penthouse lounge
rooms.diagnosis: Use the view and deep seating as the anchor; give the bar a practical evening scene.
rooms.keep: Terrace doors, windows, existing ceiling and bar.
rooms.improve: Use rich walnut storage, deep ivory seating, a quieter occasional table and restrained charcoal textiles. Keep a direct path to the terrace.
rooms.verify: Retain a direct path to the terrace with doors and cabinets open. Dim bar and seating lights separately.

rooms.title: Penthouse guest bedroom
rooms.mood: A cocoon at the top of the house
rooms.diagnosis: Keep the mushroom/charcoal identity, softened by light upholstery and oak flooring.
rooms.keep: Proposed blueprint room footprint, flat ceiling and intended door/opening relationships; enclosure still needs construction.
rooms.improve: Build the proposed room first, then add a new upholstered bed and walnut storage. Retain its mushroom/charcoal identity with oak floor and a loose rug.
rooms.verify: Field-check partitions, door, closet, electrical and HVAC routing, egress and permit requirements before pricing the new room.

rooms.title: Penthouse bathroom
rooms.diagnosis: Give guests an obvious place for towels and toiletries.
rooms.keep: Plan-led fixture arrangement; no room photo is available.
rooms.improve: One quiet porcelain family, closed vanity storage and a good mirror/light pairing.
rooms.verify: Verify all dimensions, shower door sweep and trade requirements on site before ordering.

rooms.title: Roof terrace
rooms.mood: An outdoor room with breathing space
rooms.diagnosis: Keep the skyline and fireplace visible; edit accessories and oversized pieces.
rooms.keep: Roof shape, pergola, privacy wall, fireplace and actual neighboring rooftops.
rooms.improve: Outdoor-rated seating, pale cushions and charcoal planters; a small coordinated light layer with clear circulation.
rooms.verify: Check drainage, wind exposure, rooftop load and any fixing with the responsible trade; do not penetrate the roof for styling.
